text:
tori: Hey team — quick design review from today's hallway test. Focus was the mini onboarding strip that shows on first visit. Wanted to surface a few consistency + a11y items.

ben: cool, paste the screenshot?

tori: https://drive.company/internal/designs/mini-onboard-strip-v1.png

ana: quick note: the strip header currently says "Welcome to Redwood" while the full checklist uses "Welcome to Redwood Inference". We should decide on long vs short brand name and be consistent.

ben: I'd prefer full name in full surfaces but shorter on micro surfaces. So strip = "Welcome to Redwood". Agreement?

ana: ok if that's the rule, let's document it.

mika: accessibility: the strip is implemented as a landmarkless div. Add `role=banner` or `aria-label` so screenreader users can find it. Also ensure the dismiss button has `aria-label="Dismiss onboarding strip"`.

ben: good catch. Also the strip CTA says "Start setup" which collides with some other flows. Suggest switch to "Open checklist" (secondary) and primary "Try a sample".

tori: agreement on CTA wording. We should avoid "Get started" across onboarding surfaces.

ana: mobile behavior: when the strip expands it pushes content down and the top nav becomes hidden behind the strip for a frame causing a jank. Use transform translateY for animation to avoid layout shift.

mika: reduced-motion: respect `prefers-reduced-motion` — default to a fade without translate.

ben: color contrast: the strip background is a pale blue with body text that is 14px medium. On some panels contrast drops below 4.5:1. Move to `bg-surface` token or darken the text.

ana: microcopy tweak: the subline reads "Try a curated sample or follow the checklist". Suggest shorter: "Run a curated sample or open the checklist". Active verbs first.

mika: keyboard focus: users tab into the page and focus lands on the first interactive in the page, but the strip isn't in tab order when collapsed. If we make it dismissible, ensure the strip control is reachable and the dismiss action returns focus to a logical element (e.g., the main heading).

tori: telemetry request: ops-bot can we capture `mini_onboard_shown`, `mini_onboard_dismissed`, `mini_onboard_primary_click` with user_new boolean? We'll use this to see if strip reduces time-to-first-sample.

ops-bot: noted. I'll add provisional events to the staging analytics stream. Need boolean rule for `user_new` (account_age_hours < 24).

ben: A/B candidates for primary CTA: 
- Variant A: "Try a sample"
- Variant B: "Run quick demo"
Which is clearer?

ana: I prefer Variant A — shorter and more familiar phrasing.

mika: copy for failed sample-run from research: keep it conversational: "Whoops — sample didn't run. Try again, or open the checklist to run locally. Copy error and contact support if it persists." Add `Copy error` button with aria-live feedback.

tori: action items:
- ben: update CTA labels and strip role + dismiss aria-label (PR by Thu)
- mika: add focus-return behavior + reduced-motion support (PR by Thu)
- ana: update copy variants and doc short-rule for brand usage on micro surfaces (by Wed)
- ops-bot: add analytics events to staging (ETA 48h)

ana: small visual: the pill badge for "1-min demo" uses lowercase now. Should we use sentence case `1-min demo` or `1‑Min Demo`? Design system generally prefers sentence case for badges.

ben: sentence case then. I'll update the token.

mika: QA ask: can we add a quick keyboard smoke test in the onboarding e2e to assert strip is reachable and dismiss returns focus?

ops-bot: I can add that to the suite. ETA 3 days.

tori: thanks everyone. I'll merge notes into the issue and attach the screenshot link. If no objections I'll push the wording into the component props and queue a small A/B test for two weeks.

ana: thumbs up.

ben: :thumbsup:

mika: ending thread.
